resolution: Chapter3’s broad per aliquid permits the supreme source’s per se rather than demanding a distinct producer for every existent. Chapter6 explicitly distinguishes several causal senses and denies efficient self-production of that nature. Neither through-self nor highest-nature status is silently equated with accessible-world necessity, same-world concrete support, a shared predicate or one numerical suppositum. The source’s proposed shared principle and its uniqueness conclusion remain open philosophical commitments.
